This is the first release containing Koikatsu Darkness (Part 1 out of 3, the two last parts have yet to be released by Illusion). I were informed today that bit.ly links isn't allowed here. I really don't like this rule after being made aware of its existence, but it's the rules of the land. Unfortunately adding all links in full made the post be too big for this site, so decided I should just have it on Hongfire, along with all extras/Direct Downloads and having obtained a added understanding about why I so rarely see any good torrent descriptions on this site.

If you want to get notified about new releases, feel free to join my notification discord: https://discord.gg/pSGZ4uz
